visualizerParams.title: Bug Squasher: The Boundary Value Is Excluded
visualizerParams.problemDescription: Someone aged exactly 18 is an adult, so the result should be [18,25,40], but the program prints [25,40].

solution.explanation: The rule "18 or older" includes 18, so the comparison must be >=. With > the boundary value itself is filtered out. Always test the values at the edge of a condition.
